name: Zig-zag goldenrod
desc: Zig-zag goldenrod (Solidago flexicaulis): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Solidago flexicaulis, the broadleaved goldenrod, or zigzag goldenrod, is a North American species of herbaceous perennial plants in the family Asteraceae.
